src/infrastructure/repositories/InMemoryTaskRepository.ts: InMemoryTaskRepository implements ITaskRepository using a private Map<string, Task>. findById/findAll/findByCategory/save/delete only store and read data.

parsedVerdict.reasoning: The src/infrastructure module has two adapters for the Task concern. TaskController is an inbound adapter that passes calls on to the application use-case interfaces. InMemoryTaskRepository is an outbound adapter that implements the domain's ITaskRepository port. Both are adapters around the same Task concern, so the module holds together. The controller goes through the use-case abstractions and does not reach into the repository or a concrete store, so nothing skips the intended boundaries. No rule or invariant is repeated: the controller holds no business logic, and the repository only stores data in a Map and filters it by categoryId. Neither file contains a separate unrelated concern or a second copy of logic.
